artworks.title: Petit Bosquet au Chasseur
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a man standing in a densely wooded area. The man is holding a long tool and is casting a shadow. In the background, there is a house with a thatched roof partially hidden by trees and shrubs. The scene is depicted in monochrome, with detailed brushwork capturing the intricate details of the flora and the figure.

artworks.title: Entree de Foret
artworks.medium: etching with plate tone
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image features a dense forest filled with trees stretching into the background. A thatched cottage with worn walls is on the left, with two figures nearby. A path leads to more figures and a horse further into the woods. The use of etching technique is evident in the varying line work, creating contrasts in a black and white color palette.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a person with distinct facial features. They have long, wavy hair and a wavy mustache, a neutral expression, and wear a collared shirt. The background is plain, focusing on the person. There is no jewelry or objects. The portrait is in monochrome, focusing on lines and shading.

artworks.title: Death of Seneca
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image features three people in varying poses. The central figure is an elderly man sitting on the edge of a basin, his upper body and part of his legs visible, draped with a cloth around his waist. Another figure, to the left, is sitting in patterned clothing, seemingly writing or drawing on a document. A third figure is mostly concealed, with only his head and shoulders visible. Two additional figures in the background are partially obscured by a large drapery. The setting appears to be indoors with a curtain or tapestry hanging down.

artworks.title: Sir Thomas Isham
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up. He is facing slightly left but looking directly at the viewer. He has long, curly hair, a prominent nose, and a neutral expression. The man is wearing formal attire and a cloak. The background includes an ornate frame with decorative elements.

artworks.title: Robert Greville, Lord Brooke
artworks.medium: engraving and etching
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is posed facing slightly to the right but his head is turned towards the viewer. His facial features are classically Caucasian with an oval face, a straight nose, and a neutral expression. The man has long curly hair that falls over his shoulders. He is wearing an elaborate garment with a richly patterned collar and a robe or mantle with decorative elements on the shoulders. The portrait is framed within an ornate oval border with intricate detailing, including ribbon-like decorations and a familial coat of arms beneath the portrait. The area around his head is shaded. The background includes engraving lines and shading. Below the portrait is inscribed text identifying the subject as Robert Lord Brooke, along with titles and dates.

artworks.title: Spectators Amazed
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over red, and black chalk on laid paper (laid on late eighteenth-century mount)
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 18.5 x 16.6 cm (7 5/16 x 6 9/16 in.)
support: 28.3 x 26.3 cm (11 1/8 x 10 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image shows multiple figures in various poses, with details such as clothing folds and hair differences. The figures are placed against a plain background, with a sense of movement or instruction implied by their positions.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.artist: Ignatius Cornelis Marinus after Jacob Jordaens
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image features a group of individuals gathered closely together in a room with rough stone walls. In the center, a woman seated and turned slightly to the side holds a child on her lap. The woman has pulled back hair and wears draped garments. The child is also dressed in similar fabric. Other figures in the room include an older bearded man, an older woman with a headscarf, and individuals kneeling or leaning inwards. The room is simple, with a ladder and a large basket as additional elements.

artworks.title: Iphigenia Recognizing Her Brother
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical mythological or historical scene. Six figures are standing in a structured, architectural environment, with a tree on one side and a column on the other. The figures are gathered around a small pedestal or altar with a flame rising from it. The central figure is a woman draped in flowing garments, interacting with the surrounding male figures, several of whom are adorned with spears and classical attire. The scene is framed by a building wall with niches, and detailed hatchwork indicates depth and shadow. The style reflects the influence of classical themes and Renaissance engraving, characterized by detailed line work and a focus on anatomy.

artworks.title: Guillaume Apollinaire
artworks.medium: red crayon on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund
artworks.description: The image is a stylized, abstract sketch of a person's head and shoulders. The figure is seated, facing forward. The face has exaggerated, geometric features including prominent brows, a broad nose, and full lips. The hair is depicted using textured lines. The person appears to be wearing a suit with a tie and lapel details, although simplified. A hand in the foreground suggests adjusting a tie. The background has a textured pattern resembling shelves with indistinct shapes, possibly books. The sketch is in a sepia or reddish-brown tone.

artworks.title: A Bird Perched on a Branch with Fruit
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Andrew W. Mellon Fund

artworks.title: Road by a Field of Cabbages
artworks.medium: monotype in gray and yellow on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Print Purchase Fund (Rosenwald Collection)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a tree on the left and a cluster of pumpkins or gourds under the tree. The horizon is visible in the distance, with structures faintly seen against the sky. The color palette is warm and muted with earthy tones. The brushwork is textured and soft, creating a gentle movement in the landscape.

artworks.title: Title Plate
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite
artworks.creditLine: W.G. Russell Allen, Ailsa Mellon Bruce, Lessing J. Rosenwald, and Pepita Milmore Funds
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural composition. The image shows a stone structure with various architectural elements and inscriptions. There is a central stone tablet with Italian text, surrounded by decorative motifs like a draped garland and chain. The drawing includes stairs, ramps, and arches, suggesting depth and perspective. The artwork uses detailed line work and shading to depict texture and dimension, creating a complex and somewhat foreboding atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Round Tower
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing
artworks.creditLine: W.G. Russell Allen, Ailsa Mellon Bruce, Lessing J. Rosenwald, and Pepita Milmore Funds
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with grand staircases. The drawing shows a large, cavernous space filled with towering stone structures, massive staircases, and ornate details. Multiple arches and vaulted ceilings are depicted, with bridges and railings crossing the space in complex patterns. The drawing has a sense of depth and scale, with heavy shading and detailed line work creating rich textures and intricate architectural details, giving it a mysterious, dream-like quality.

artworks.title: The Grand Piazza
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing
artworks.creditLine: W.G. Russell Allen, Ailsa Mellon Bruce, Lessing J. Rosenwald, and Pepita Milmore Funds
artworks.description: The image shows a stone archway leading to a detailed bridge structure. The bridge is intricately carved and stretches across the scene. Swirling clouds can be seen in the sky beyond the bridge. The horizon is partially hidden, revealing hints of a cityscape with towers. The brushstrokes are varied, with heavier lines for the arch and lighter strokes for the sky. The color scheme is grayscale, emphasizing contrast and shading.

artworks.title: The Smoking Fire
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing
artworks.creditLine: W.G. Russell Allen, Ailsa Mellon Bruce, Lessing J. Rosenwald, and Pepita Milmore Funds
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural fantasy scene. The drawing includes enormous stone structures, bridges, and staircases within an imaginary architectural space. The arches and vaulted ceilings, light and shadows through cross-hatching techniques, stone walkways and ramps, architectural details such as railings, columns, and openings, and a monochromatic palette with contrasts of light and dark are all featured.

artworks.title: The Drawbridge
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, scratching
artworks.creditLine: W.G. Russell Allen, Ailsa Mellon Bruce, Lessing J. Rosenwald, and Pepita Milmore Funds
artworks.description: The image shows a network of intersecting lines and arches creating a complex composition of forms. Staircases and bridges lead to various platforms and structures. Elements resemble cogs, beams, and towers, suggesting connection to architectural or mechanical constructs.

artworks.title: The Staircase with Trophies
artworks.medium: etching, engraving
artworks.creditLine: W.G. Russell Allen, Ailsa Mellon Bruce, Lessing J. Rosenwald, and Pepita Milmore Funds
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate architectural fantasy scene featuring a grand staircase and complex structures. The drawing depicts a vast interior space filled with arches, staircases, and towering columns. The use of cross-hatching creates a sense of depth and shadows, emphasizing the monumental size and complex structure of the environment. There is a large staircase that dominates the foreground, leading to different levels within the structure. The intricate details suggest an architectural labyrinth, with various walkways and ledges connecting the different parts of the space. The artwork is detailed and captures a fantastical, otherworldly setting that invites exploration through its dynamic composition. The artist skillfully utilizes linework to depict the grandiosity and intricacy of the fictional architecture.

artworks.title: The Giant Wheel
artworks.medium: etching, engraving
artworks.creditLine: W.G. Russell Allen, Ailsa Mellon Bruce, Lessing J. Rosenwald, and Pepita Milmore Funds
artworks.description: The image portrays intersecting lines and geometric shapes, with arch-like curves intersecting at various angles. The composition resembles a massive architectural structure like a scaffold or unfinished monument. Jagged blocks are piled at the base, resembling a giant pedestal. Figures are scattered on top of the blocks. Detailed shading and cross-hatching add depth to the portrayal.

artworks.title: Prisoners on a Projecting Platform
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing
artworks.creditLine: W.G. Russell Allen, Ailsa Mellon Bruce, Lessing J. Rosenwald, and Pepita Milmore Funds
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate architectural space. The image depicts an intricately detailed interior with towering arches, multiple levels, railings, and staircases. The composition features contrasts between shadows and illuminated areas, creating a dramatic atmosphere. The architecture blends classical and fantastical elements, with grand arched openings and ornate details. The space conveys depth, suggesting a vast interior. Several statues or figures are visible atop platforms within the scene.

artworks.title: The Arch with a Shell Ornament
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, scratching, sulphur tint or open bite, drypoint
artworks.creditLine: W.G. Russell Allen, Ailsa Mellon Bruce, Lessing J. Rosenwald, and Pepita Milmore Funds
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior scene with arches and elaborate details. It features expansive arches dominating the upper section, a large gridded opening below, varied lighting, a complex piece on the right, and naturalistic elements on the lower left. The intricate details and line work showcase architectural elements and textures with precision.

artworks.title: The Sawhorse
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, scratching
artworks.creditLine: W.G. Russell Allen, Ailsa Mellon Bruce, Lessing J. Rosenwald, and Pepita Milmore Funds
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting an architectural interior with sweeping arches, light and shadow play, and intricate details. The composition features a horizon line, an architectural structure, and a bridge-like element cutting horizontally across the scene. The etched lines create a textured effect reminiscent of aged stone and shadowy spaces. The color palette is monochrome, emphasizing contrast and depth. Figures and architectural details are visible in the foreground, leading to vast, dark arches in the distance with light filtering through openings.

artworks.title: The Well
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, scratching, burnishing, lavis
artworks.creditLine: W.G. Russell Allen, Ailsa Mellon Bruce, Lessing J. Rosenwald, and Pepita Milmore Funds
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural scene. The composition depicts a grand, labyrinthine interior space filled with elaborate masonry and towering structures. In the foreground, substantial machinery and scaffolding can be seen. The midground features stairs leading to different levels of the structure, with stone figures and decorative elements. Light and shadow provide depth to the architecture. The drawing captures a complex interplay of structural elements and textures, creating a dramatic atmosphere. This architectural fantasy is reminiscent of the works typical of Giovanni Battista Piranesi, known for his engravings of imaginary prisons and monumental architectural subjects.

artworks.title: The Gothic Arch
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, and burnishing
artworks.creditLine: W.G. Russell Allen, Ailsa Mellon Bruce, Lessing J. Rosenwald, and Pepita Milmore Funds
artworks.description: The etching provides a wide and slightly elevated perspective of a complex architectural space resembling an elaborate dungeon or underground structure. The space is enclosed within massive stone structures and arches, with etched lines creating depth and scale through bold, dark strokes emphasizing the stonework's heaviness and intricacy. Lighter, finer lines add texture and detail. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink highlighting shadows and details against the light etching paper. In the foreground, intersecting staircases with railings are depicted, while figures can be seen navigating through arches in the distance, contrasting with the towering pillars and beams dominating the scene.
